mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the market prices in higher risk of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL yoy change against 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, the combination signals imminent policy response causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL yoy change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term against 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 5% AND UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for UNRATE change against 5-day returns in high unemployment regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC for HOUST against 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 99, it signals dual weakness in housing and manufacturing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 900 AND INDPRO < 99, or the Rank IC for the interaction term against 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low demand regimes (RSAFS < 400,000), a rise in residential sales (RSAFS) signals improving consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where RSAFS < 400 AND RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC for RSAFS change against 5-day returns in low demand regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low industrial production index (INDPRO < 99) signals weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 99, or the Rank IC for INDPRO against 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
